    """Get all foreground cells in the same connected component (8-way)"""
    visited = set()
    cells = []
    stack = [(start_r, start_c)]
    while stack:
        r, c = stack.pop()
        key = (r, c)
        if key in visited:
            continue
        visited.add(key)
        cells.append((r, c))
        for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:
